senses.gloss:
[dakṣacaraṇa]
--Nyāyasūtravṛtti. C.. III. 390.
Extract agrees with Nyāyasūtroddhāra of Vācaspatimiśra.

[Dattakakramasaṅgraha]
by Kṛṣṇatarkālaṅkāra Bhaṭṭācārya. Mandlik Sup. 154.
Same a. Dāyādhikārakramasaṅgraha (?).

[Damrabodha
disciple of Umaraprakāśa or Amaraprakāśa].
--C. Prapañcasārasambandhadīpikā on Prapañcasāra of Śaṅkarācārya. RASB. VIII. A. 6175.
Same a. Uttamabodha.

[dayāraṇyaśrīpāda]
--C. on the Tarkadīpikā of Viśvanāthāśrama. Baroda 1753 (b).
Mistake for Advayāraṇya.

[Darśanakramopadeśasaptadaśāloka]
Bud. by Śrīkūṭa. Cordier III. p. 133.

[Darśanasāgaragaṇi]
--Upadeśaśataka. BORI. 553 of 1892-95.
Real a. is Vibudhavimalasūri.

[Daśaratha]
--Śanaiścarastotra. IM. 4802. Jodhpur 2003. Prob. same a. Ś. stotra from Skandapurāṇa.
Pt.. Stotraratnākara, II. p. 551-52. Vavilla Press, Madras 1929.

[Dānakā]
bhāṇikā. by Rūpagosvāmin. mentioned in Col. Vaiṣṇavatoṣiṇī. L. 2125. [Reading should be dAnakelyAkhyA]. See Dānakelikaumudī.

[Dāyabhāgasiddhāntakumudacandrikā]
[by Rāmabhadra] NW. 144. This is C. by Acyuta Cakravartin on Dāyabhāga of Jīmūtavāhana.

[Dālbhya]
--Apāmārjanastotra. This is actually from Viṣṇudharmottarapurāṇa; spoken by Pulastya to Dālbhya. See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 254b.
Addl. mss.: CPB. 2197. IM. 9384 (Viṣṇustotra). IO. 6606 (Śrīviṣṇorapāmārjanastotra). Oudh XI. 4.
